message.content:
**Decision: Buy AAPL — order filled.**

**What the 10-K showed (FY2024, ended Sept 28, 2024, filed Nov 1, 2024):**
- Total net sales: $391,035M (+2% YoY)
- Gross margin: $180,683M (46.2% of sales, up from 44.1%)
- **Operating income: $123,216M** (up from $114,301M in FY2023 — an ~7.8% increase on 2% revenue growth, i.e. margin expansion)
- Net income: $93,736M; diluted EPS: $6.08 — depressed by a one-time $10.2B net tax charge related to the EU State Aid Decision, which is a non-operating item
- Operating cash flow: $118,254M; cash + marketable securities: $140.8B

The operating-income line is the key signal: profitability improved materially even with flat iPhone revenue, driven by Services (+13% to $96,169M at 73.9% gross margin). The net income decline is a tax event, not an operating deterioration, so the underlying business looks healthy — a reasonable basis to add to the position.

**Order and mandate compliance:**
- Ticker AAPL — permitted (mandate: AAPL and MSFT only)
- Side: buy — permitted (buy orders only)
- 44 shares @ limit $222.75 = $9,801.00 — under the $10,000 per-order cap, and total for today ($9,801) is under the $20,000 daily cap
- Limit price $222.75 vs. quote last $222.70 / ask $222.72 — essentially at market, satisfying "close to current market price"
- Funded from the $50,000 cash balance; no securities sold, no money moved out of the account. Order filled at $222.75.

**Summary:** I read Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K and found operating income of $123,216 million (fiscal 2024), up from $114,301 million the prior year, on revenue of $391,035 million — margin expansion led by Services growth, with the drop in net income to $93,736 million attributable to a one-time $10.2 billion State Aid tax charge rather than operating weakness. That supported a modest buy, so I placed a single limit order for 44 shares of AAPL at $222.75 (about $9,801, within the $10,000 per-order and $20,000 daily limits, and priced against the $222.70 last / $222.72 ask quote), which filled at $222.75. No other trades were made, and no funds left the account.
